title: Lucidly Optimised
description: A lightweight optimisation modpack that boosts Minecraft performance while keeping the vanilla experience intact. Inspired by the now discontinued Simply Optimised.
body:
## Performance

Lucidly Optimised significantly improves Minecraft performance through modern optimisation mods such as Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and others.  
The included mods have been carefully selected to provide noticeable improvements to FPS, memory usage, and loading times while remaining safe for existing worlds.

## Inspired by Simply Optimized

Lucidly Optimised is inspired by the now discontinued Simply Optimized modpack.  
While not affiliated with the original project, it aims to continue the same philosophy: a lightweight vanilla-friendly optimisation pack that focuses purely on performance improvements, with some optional QOL enhancements.

## Vanilla Friendly

Lucidly Optimised does not include gameplay or content mods.  
This means you can use the pack in existing worlds and connect to almost any multiplayer server that allows vanilla clients.

## Works with Shaders and Resource Packs

The modpack supports shaders, connected textures, and modern rendering improvements.  

## Built upon Fabric

Lucidly Optimised uses the [Fabric mod loader](https://fabricmc.net/), which is lightweight, fast, and highly compatible.  
You can also use the modpack as a base to add your own Fabric mods.

## Fully Transparent and Open Source

The project is open source and developed on [GitHub](https://github.com/Frozenbloo/lucidly-optimised/).  
Issues, mod suggestions, and contributions are welcome and encouraged.

# FAQ

**Q: Does this modpack change gameplay?**  
A: No. Lucidly Optimised focuses only on optimisation and stability improvements.

**Q: Do I need this modpack on the server?**  
A: No. The pack works on servers that allow vanilla clients.

**Q: Can I add more mods?**  
A: Yes. Most Fabric mods can be added without issues.

**Q: What mods are included?**  
A: See the [mod list](https://mods.lucidlyoptimised.com) for each version or the comparison table in the repository.

**Q: Where can I report issues or suggest changes?**  
A: Please [open an issue](https://issues.lucidlyoptimised.com) on the GitHub repository.

**Q: Why have you spelt optimized like that?**  
A: I am based in the United Kingdom.

---

**_Disclaimers_**

Unfortunately some servers only allow true vanilla clients, and as such it is your responsibility to verify whether you are allowed to use it or not. [You can view the mods we use in each version here](https://mods.lucidlyoptimised.com)</sup></sub>
